$comment: One JSON object per line in data/<tier>/<library>.jsonl. Enforced by scripts/ci/validate_records.py on added lines only. Staging records of a library with a corpus (schemas/sources.json) must carry source_path and context. Contributors add one file per PR: data/staging/<library>/<anything>.jsonl. `upstream` (optional): for a record from an aggregating source (Lean Pool), the repository the project was imported from, at its commit. `headline` (optional, true): one of the at most ten results a PR is about; it carries an `Author:` credit in its statement.

tombstone.$comment: Appending {"tombstone": "<name>", ...} retracts a record. The generator drops it; history stays. `category` (required on a new tombstone) is one of tombstone_categories and never changes.

tombstone_note.$comment: Where to look instead of a retracted record ({"tombstone_note": "<name>", "note": "...", "see": [...]}). Unlike the tombstone it can change as the library changes: append a new one and the newest wins; the old ones stay as history. `see`: tengoku names or http(s) links.

credit_correction.$comment: Plagiarism is the one case where credit changes, and only with evidence: {"credit_correction": "<name>", "credit": "Author: ...", "evidence": "https://..."}. The record is never edited; the generated module shows the corrected credit and the evidence. The newest correction wins.
